mp-2NSb.title: Road: lots of road reflectors
mp-2NSb.summary: Roads often have a very large number of reflective studs. Guam is the same, so this narrows it to the Northern Marianas or Guam.

mp-7SWm.title: Vegetation: dense, low tropical growth
mp-7SWm.summary: A tropical island look with thick, fairly low vegetation. Useful to confirm a Pacific island, not to pick between islands.

mp-H2l8.title: Pole: wooden, often with a crossbar
mp-H2l8.summary: Wooden utility poles, frequently with a crossbar at the top. Guam mostly has concrete poles instead.

mp-H5Sf.title: Coverage: only the main island
mp-H5Sf.summary: Only the main island, Saipan, has car coverage. Islands to the north have none, and Tinian and the small island south of Saipan only have tripod (backpack-style) coverage.

mp-MPiv.title: Landscape: steep cliff with bare rock
mp-MPiv.summary: Near the northern tip of the island there is a tall cliff with a lot of exposed rock face.

mp-QEJK.title: Google car: fully blurred, close antenna
mp-QEJK.summary: The whole car is blurred, but you can see an antenna at the front right, sitting close to the camera. On Guam it looks farther away.

differs.how: Guam's antenna sits farther from the camera
Puerto Rico has no front plates and Spanish signs

mp-c1Di.title: Plants: wide tree with bright red flowers
mp-c1Di.summary: Look for a wide-crowned tree covered in bright red flowers (Royal Poinciana). It is very common here but not common on Guam.

differs.how: Guam rarely has these red-flowered trees

mp-jle0.title: Street sign: blue name plates
mp-jle0.summary: Street name signs are blue. Guam's are green, so blue points to the Northern Marianas.

mp-lSGS.title: Language: East Asian scripts on signs
mp-lSGS.summary: Japanese, Chinese, Korean and even Russian text is common on signs. Guam is the same, so it narrows it to the two.

mp-sU1n.title: Region: dense shops on the west coast
mp-sU1n.summary: In the southern half of the west coast you find dense commercial areas with many shops and businesses.
